name: Jellyfin Federation
overview: Allows jellyfin servers to federate with each other
description: This Jellyfin plugin allows multiple Jellyfin servers to federate, sharing media libraries in real-time without syncing or copying files. Media can be streamed from one server to another with live transcoding if necessary.

versions.changelog: Faster friend video at home over a direct link. One download from a friend's server can stop well short of your line's speed (about 110 Mbps in testing), so 4K could buffer. Now, while your player watches one piece of a friend's video, your server already fetches the next three over the link at the same time, so playback gets the speed of several downloads (about 178 Mbps in the same test). Only the server watching needs 0.0.197; your friend doesn't have to update. Seeking drops what was fetched for the old spot; memory use is capped at 384 MB. Includes everything in 0.0.196.
